title: Serve on web-standard runtimes
excerpt: Serve on web standard runtimes Mount the handler createMcpHandler returns a { fetch } object — the shape Cloudflare Workers, Deno, and Bun expect from a module's default export — so export default handler mounts it. The deployed worker answers MCP requests on every path, with no Node adapter and no body middleware. The factory runs once per request, so a fresh McpServer serves every call: Serve over HTTP covers that model.
